triples.head_surface: backflow of water from the sea
triples.tail_surface: automatic non-return valve with a positive means of closing it from a position above the freeboard deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 带干舷甲板以上正关装置的自动止回阀
triples.evidence_text:
Gravity discharge pipes led overboard from any watertight space are to be fitted with an effective and accessible means, as described below, to prevent backflow of water from the sea into that space. The requirements for non-return valves in this subparagraph are applicable only to those discharges which remain open during the normal operation of the vessel.
Normally, each separate discharge is to have one automatic non-return valve with a positive means of closing it from a position above the freeboard deck.

triples.head_surface: backflow of water from the sea
triples.tail_surface: one automatic non-return valve and one positive closing valve controlled from above the freeboard deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 一个自动止回阀和一个干舷甲板以上控制的正关阀
triples.evidence_text: Alternatively, one automatic non-return valve and one positive closing valve controlled from above the freeboard deck may be accepted.

triples.head_surface: backflow of water from the sea
triples.tail_surface: two automatic non-return valves without positive means of closing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 两个无正关装置的自动止回阀
triples.evidence_text: However, where the vertical distance from the summer load waterline (or, where assigned, timber summer load waterline) to the inboard end of the discharge pipe exceeds 0.01 L (where L is the freeboard length of the vessel, as defined in 3-1-1/3.3), the discharge may have two automatic non-return valves without positive means of closing, provided that the inboard non-return valve is always accessible for examination under all service conditions, that is, it is located above the tropical load waterline (or, where assigned, timber tropical load waterline.)

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 所有营运工况下的检查
triples.evidence_text: provided that the inboard non-return valve is always accessible for examination under all service conditions, that is, it is located above the tropical load waterline (or, where assigned, timber tropical load waterline.)

triples.head_surface: backflow of water from the sea
triples.evidence_text: If this is impracticable, a locally operated positive closing valve may be provided between the two non-return valves, in which case, the inboard non-return valve need not be located above the specified tropical load waterline.
